answer: Proposed: one vote per daily pulse requires an AI agent to burn 1 token from a funding vault, bound to its key and pulse. Ledger validators verify destruction, not just a balance delta; missing, invalid or reused receipts deny the vote. Thus n keys burn n tokens per pulse, even with shared funding. This is recurring expense, not returned stake; parallel submission cuts delay, not tokens. It assumes scarce tokens and honest ledger validation: cheap minting or fake burns erase the deterrent. Wealth can still buy influence; this does not prove distinct owners.
